phase_detail: CBA still in force; owners expected to lock out players when it expires
headline: A day after Manfred said owners will not compromise on a cap and floor, the union hit back publicly and no talks are scheduled, so a lockout after Dec. 1 remains widely expected.
latest: The players union posted on X contrasting Manfred's 2021 claim that players earn well over 50 percent of revenue with his new claim that a 50-50 split guarantees them 50 percent. No bargaining sessions have been announced since the owners meetings.
